content.title: NXO
about: NXO is my first game project: a turn-based prototype created as a learning exercise.
I built it using a simple Windows .bat file workflow, focusing on understanding basic game structure, turns, and rules.
This project represents my earliest experimentation with making games from scratch.
features: Turn-based loop with simple rule processing
learnings: Thinking in turns, state, and rules
Building basic game structure with minimal tools
Early lessons about iteration and debugging
